parameters.name: MaxResults
parameters.description: The maximum number of records to return in this request.

parameters.name: NextToken
parameters.description: The pagination token. If there is a next page, this field has a return value. If this parameter returns data, there is a next page. You can use the returned NextToken as a request parameter to retrieve the next page of data until the return value is Null, which indicates that all data has been retrieved.

parameters.name: ProtectionPolicyId
parameters.description: The ID of the protection policy.

parameters.name: SubProtectionPolicyType
parameters.description: The type of the sub-protection policy.

parameters.name: TaskId
parameters.description: The task ID. You can call DescribeTasks to query the task ID.
